input.title: Halloween app icon (App Store + Google Play)
input.description:
Halloween version of the live ZM3D app icon (live since Sep 17, App Store + Google Play), for the Halloween push.

**Call:** Halloween version, new work (none exists yet).
**Direction (Robert):** keep it as simple as the current icon. The Sep 17 draft in #zombie-art was too busy at icon size; it's fine for an event, not the icon. Only the seasonal layer changes (per *Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025*).
**Due:** merged by **Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT** (the Oct 17 submission merge cut, per Arthur's Q4 release calendar). The icon ships in the build, so it can't swap on its own date: it goes live with the Oct 17 build, which should be live on iOS from about Wed Oct 22 once Apple review clears. It reverts in the Nov 6 submission.
**Owner:** Martin. Hand off to engineering early enough to make the merge cut.

input.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
input.bodyText:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art). For review Thu Oct 2. Comment anywhere.
Tracker (every live surface, one row each): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1iPVHXtpzN_RxXpTtXEHM6Bll_LgCLdPu4-GgFVlZ5lI/edit

1. Goal
Leonard's ask (#zombie_marketing, Sep 30): everything players see from us should look like Halloween for the last stretch of October, meaning the store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers everything live today (Oct 1): the 4 store surfaces, plus 58 Unity creatives (56 on the live creatives sheet, plus 2 that are live but missing from it).

2. Dates that drive everything
- Sun Oct 12: the Android US tablet campaign ends, so anything that only runs there gets no Halloween version (Frederick, Sep 30).
- Wed Oct 15: every Halloween ad has to be with Frederick. Unity needs creatives uploaded and approved before the flight starts. (This replaces the Oct 17 date in his Sep 12 draft.)
- Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT: merge cut for the Oct 17 submission, the last build that can carry Halloween changes. The icon and new iOS screenshots have to be in by then (Arthur's Q4 release calendar).
- Sat Oct 18 to Fri Oct 31: the Halloween flight on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone.
- About Wed Oct 22: the Oct 17 build and iOS store listing go live (Apple review is taking up to 3 days).
- Nov 6: the clean-up submission puts the icon and screenshots back to normal.

3. How each call was made (Robert's Seasonal art direction, Q4 2025)
- Halloween version: dress it from the current art. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment). Same flat background, pose, zombie order and CTA, so the variant still tests clean against the normal one.
- Refresh first: re-capture, re-render or re-cut before any seasonal pass. This applies to anything captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap and new background), unless a later capture has replaced it. It also applies to any video whose master has music baked in, which gets re-cut from a no-music master.
- Reuse: it already has a seasonal version, so we use that.
- Skip: no seasonal version this time.
Capture builds and master audio come from the comments on each ART ticket.

4. Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play): Halloween version, new work. Martin, ART-855, merged by Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT. Robert's note on the Sep 17 draft: too busy at icon size, so keep it as simple as the current icon.
  On "swap the icon around the 24th": the icon ships inside the build, so it can't change on a date of our choosing. It goes out with the Oct 17 submission and should be live on iOS from about Wed Oct 22, then reverts with the Nov 6 submission. If we want it later than that, it would need its own submission, which Arthur's calendar doesn't have.
- iPhone 6.5" set: Reuse. Martin exported the Halloween set Sep 30 (ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store, 5 screens, same comps with the seasonal layer on top). It has to go into the Oct 17 submission by the Oct 16 cut. No ticket, since exported work is done (Leonard, #zombie-art).
- iPad 12.9" set: Halloween version, new work. Martin, ART-856, due Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT. It's the only store set without a Halloween export, and iOS screenshots can only change with a new version.
- Google Play phone set: Reuse. Martin exported the 6 screens Sep 30. Play graphics aren't tied to a build (upload any day, 1 day for review). Proposed: upload by Fri Oct 17 so it's live for the Oct 18 flight start, and swap back after Oct 31. We need to confirm at the review who uploads.

5. Ads: the calls (full list in the tracker's Ads tab)
- Halloween version, 13, all Marcus, due Wed Oct 15:
  cheer fastcouch 9:16 / 16:9 / 4:5 (ART-808, 816, 851); marcus.bennett 16:9 / 4:5 / 1:1 (ART-817, 818, 819); end card 001 9:16 / 16:9 / 1:1 / 4:5 (ART-833, 834, 835, 848); barrel marketing2 1:1 (ART-852); couch alpha 50 4:5 (ART-853); balloons alpha 50 (1) 16:9 (ART-854).
  Note: Marcus's Sep 29 cheer fastcouch Halloween test can't be reused. It sits on the July capture with the old background (Robert, Sep 30), so the 9:16 and 16:9 get redone from the Sep 16 #1896 capture, which Marcus has already agreed to do.
- Refresh first, then Halloween version, 35, due Wed Oct 15:
  Marcus (29 videos and end cards): couch boss 30 9:16 / 16:9 (ART-793, 843); couch alpha 30 (794); couch alpha 50 9:16 / 16:9 (795, 823); balloons alpha 50 (796, music baked in); balloons alpha 50 (1) (797); barrel alpha 30 (798, music); couch marketing2 30s (799, music); the 9:16 endcard cuts (800, 801, 802 music, 803, 804); barrel marketing2 4:5 (805); cheer 30p 9:16 / 4:5 (807, 847, music); marcus.bennett 9:16 (809, the live cut is from the music master, so re-cut from Marcus's Aug 13 no-music export); squirrelfail portrait (810), mrfluffernot portrait (812), cinematicTutorial Ad 1 9:16 / 16:9 (814, 845) and tutorialCinematic portrait / 1:1 (815, 846), all prototype captures from Dec 2024; portrait UA end card (831, #1450 is one build before the swap, and it plays after every Android US phone video); end card template 16:9 (832); boris fastcouch 9:16 (840) and boris alin2 9:16 / 16:9 (841, 850), Jul 28 captures.
  Martin (6 statics): julia 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9, 1:1 android 1080, 4:5 android 1080x1350 (ART-825 to 830), all made from Jun 5 #852 captures.
  Shortcut: for couch alpha 50, balloons alpha 50 (1) and barrel marketing2, current captures already exist from the Sep 17 to 25 re-exports (#1896, #1935, #1966) and can be the base for the other cuts.
- Reuse, 0: no ad has a shippable seasonal version yet.
- Skip, 10: these only run on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12. barrel marketing2 16:9 (806), squirrelfail landscape (811), mrfluffernot landscape (813), cheer 30p 16:9 (820), couch alpha 30 16:9 (821), balloons alpha 50 16:9 (822), barrel alpha 30 endcard 16:9 (824), boris fastcouch 16:9 (842), couch marketing2 30s 16:9 (844), julia 1:1 android tablet (849). Squirrelfail and mrfluffernot landscape came off iOS UK tablet on Sep 29.
- Two live ads missing from the live creatives sheet, both counted in: julia 4:5 "They're coming, stop them!" (ART-826), still on iOS UK and our best CPI there (Frederick, Trello, Sep 30); and Marcus's portrait UA end card (ART-831) on Android US phone. Frederick, can you add them to the sheet?

6. Who makes what by when
- Marcus: 42 ad deliverables to Frederick by Wed Oct 15 (13 Halloween versions, plus 29 that need a refresh first).
- Martin: 6 julia statics (refresh, then Halloween) to Frederick by Wed Oct 15; the Halloween icon (ART-855) and iPad 12.9" set (ART-856) by Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT. The iPhone and Google Play sets are already done.
- Frederick: queue the uploads from the ART tickets; each ad ticket now has its call and due date in a comment, and the ones needing work are assigned.
- Arthur: the Oct 17 submission carries the Halloween icon plus the iPhone 6.5" and iPad 12.9" screenshots; Nov 6 reverts them.

7. Risks and decisions for Thursday
- Marcus's load. 42 video deliverables in two weeks, 29 of which need a re-capture or re-cut first, is a lot for one person. Options: (a) Frederick re-cuts the ones he originally made (most of the Apr couch/balloons/barrel cuts) from fresh captures and Marcus does the seasonal pass; (b) we cut the refresh list down to the best performers on each campaign and pause the rest for the flight; (c) a mix. We need a decision at the review.
- Proposed internal checkpoint, not a hard date: refreshed (pre-Halloween) cuts done by about Fri Oct 10, leaving the last few days for the seasonal pass and Robert's review before Oct 15.
- Icon timing: it lands with the build (about Oct 22), not on a chosen date. Confirm that's OK with Leonard.
- Google Play upload: who owns it, and is Fri Oct 17 the right date?

ART tickets: new store art is ART-855 (icon) and ART-856 (iPad set). Every live ad ticket (ART-793 to 835, 840 to 854) has a comment with its call and due date.

Halloween plan + tracker are ready for Thursday's review, shared with everyone on the invite so you can comment:
• Plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/3689969d8464f26864b5769b/edit
• Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1iPVHXtpzN_RxXpTtXEHM6Bll_LgCLdPu4-GgFVlZ5lI/edit

Quick version:
• *Ads (58 live):* 13 Halloween version, 35 refresh first (pre-Jul 29 capture or music baked in), 10 skip (Android US tablet only, which ends Oct 12), 0 reuse. Everything is due to Frederick *Wed Oct 15* for the Oct 18-31 flight. Every ART ticket has its call and due date in a comment, and the 48 that need work are assigned (Marcus 42, Martin 6), so Frederick can queue from them.
• *Store:* the iPhone 6.5" and GP Halloween sets are already exported (reuse). New tickets for the rest: <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-855|ART-855> Halloween icon and <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-856|ART-856> iPad 12.9" set, both Martin, both due at the Oct 16 12:00 PT merge cut.
• *Icon on the 24th:* it ships in the build, so it goes out with the Oct 17 submission and should be live on iOS around Oct 22, not on a date we pick. It reverts Nov 6.
• To decide Thursday: Marcus's load (42 items, 29 need a re-capture first), and who uploads the GP set (proposed by Oct 17).
• Also counted in two live ads that aren't on the live sheet: julia 4:5 (ART-826) and the portrait UA end card (ART-831).
